With her husband, Daniel H. Wells, Emmeline met Ulysses S. Grant and James A. Garfield in 1875 (five years before Garfield’s election to the U.S. presidency). Emmeline had private audiences with Rutherford B. Hayes in 1879, Grover Cleveland in 1886, and Theodore Roosevelt in 1902, and in 1919 Woodrow Wilson visited her at home to commend her war efforts during World War I. She also attended the inauguration of William McKinley in 1901.
